final.role: Converts documents between dozens of markup formats (docx, html, epub, org, etc. to Markdown) to feed notes into the hub
final.evidence: Pandoc is a Haskell library for converting from one markup format to another, and a command-line tool that uses this library.

o_que_mudou: role: converts Markdown to plain text/JSON for indexing -> converts many input formats (docx, html, epub...) into Markdown, README lists readers and writers
conferencia.nota: Useful as an ingestion converter (docx/html/pdf-adjacent to Markdown) before indexing; not a search tool.
